# H & H Custom Cabinetry

> H & H Custom Cabinetry designs custom kitchens, bathroom vanities, built-ins, and storage solutions for homeowners across the Greater Toronto and Hamilton Area (GTHA).

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://hhcustomcabinetry.ca/): Company overview, featured work, and process
- [Services](https://hhcustomcabinetry.ca/services/): Custom kitchens, vanities, built-ins, and other cabinetry
- [Gallery](https://hhcustomcabinetry.ca/gallery/): Completed cabinetry projects
- [About](https://hhcustomcabinetry.ca/about/): Experience, approach, and showroom information
- [Contact](https://hhcustomcabinetry.ca/contact/): Quote, appointment, telephone, email, and showroom options
